declared_degradations.summary: a subagent takes its agent's configured permissions until the driver applies the session's rules to it
a subagent's tools run without the lease's environment or identity, which the driver never applies to a child

rows.name: managed_service
rows.summary: `service start` returned at once, the service registered itself, and this client found it through the registration and authenticated with its password

rows.name: caller_named_session
rows.summary: a runner-minted id, location, model with variant, rules, and metadata read back unchanged

rows.name: session_environment
rows.summary: the environment reaches shell tools, replaces rather than merges, and no other session sees it; a child does not inherit it

rows.name: prompt_and_completion
rows.summary: a prompt with newlines and quotes reached the model verbatim, and the settled tree was observed by polling alone with no event stream open

rows.name: service_restart
rows.summary: a restart changed the registration id and pid, the driver core recognized it by identity, the service did not resume the turn, and the session was prompted normally afterward; its environment did not survive

rows.name: concurrent_sessions
rows.summary: two fleet sessions and an operator session ran at once with no environment, rule, or permission request crossing between them

rows.name: interrupt
rows.summary: an interrupt stopped a turn mid-tool, ended the tool's process, and recorded `interrupted`; interrupting a running child before its root settled both

rows.name: judgement
rows.summary: a resumed session's final root assistant text carries `<Choice>` and the assessment, apart from tool output

rows.name: queue_and_steer
rows.summary: a `queue` prompt to an idle session started a turn, and a `steer` prompt to a running one landed at its next step boundary

rows.name: usage_and_cost
rows.summary: session and message records carry tokens and cost, for the root and each child apart; cost was zero on this model

rows.name: pricing
rows.summary: the model listing carries no prices for this model, so cost cannot be estimated when a step reports none; OpenCode withholds them for a model a subscription login covers

rows.name: errors_and_limits
rows.summary: unknown model and unknown variant fail live as `provider.no-route`; provider refusal, usage limit with its reset, and overload are distinguishable structured errors in 2.1.4's error mapping

rows.name: permission_rules
rows.summary: a shell-pattern deny failed its call with `permission.rejected` and the turn went on; a tool denied for every resource, as an MCP server's tools are, is withheld from the model and never runs; an update replaces a session's rules

rows.name: permission_requests
rows.summary: an `ask` raised a request that held the turn until `session.permission.reply` answered it, each reply took effect, and a form waited until it was cancelled

rows.name: events
rows.summary: every `session.*` event carries its session id, for the root and its child alike

rows.name: child_agents
rows.summary: a `subagent` call created a child whose `parentID` is the root and whose id the spawning tool part records; a finished background child woke its root through the inbox

rows.name: transcript_read
rows.summary: messages read in order live and after completion keep their ids, and an in-progress message read again by id is complete; tool states seen live: running

rows.name: transcript_tools
rows.summary: the read and skill tools ran and recorded their input; the message listing pages forward through an opaque cursor to an empty last page, and a missing session answers 404

rows.name: compaction
rows.summary: a requested compaction produced a `compaction` message distinct from retained history

rows.name: model_and_variant
rows.summary: the model and variant held across fresh mint, resume, and judgement, and the listing names the variant

rows.name: takeover
rows.summary: `opencode --session <id>` opened the session after its rules were replaced and continued it on the same session; it recorded agent-switched

rows.name: version
rows.summary: `--version` normalizes to 2.1.4 and `GET /api/info` reports the same

rows.name: store_migration
rows.summary: OpenCode 2 migrated the 1.18.33 store in place and marked it with `kv` `migration.v1-v2`; OpenCode 1 still lists and exports it
